title: Edmonton Brewery Tour (10 person minimum group)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

blurb: Welcome to Edmonton's only Shuttle Guided Brewery Tour! Whether you are a tourist visiting the great city of Edmonton, or a local looking to enjoy a night out with friends and explore what your great city has to offer. Canadian Craft Tour's Edmonton Brewery Tour package is a perfect introduction to the craft beer scene in Edmonton with an educational behind the Scenes tour, tastings, transportation by shuttle and custom pick ups and drop offs.
